title: Carnitas Tacos
description: A classic Mexican dish featuring slow-cooked pork, served in a crispy taco shell with your favorite toppings.
instructions: Heat the lard or oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the pork chunks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chili powder, cumin, and salt, and stir to combine.
Transfer the pork to the oven and cook at 300°F (150°C) for 2-1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir to combine with the cooking liquid.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the pork onto a tortilla, followed by your desired toppings.
Serve immediately and garnish with chopped cilantro.
